// workflow.ts
export const machine = createMachine({ initial: 'check', states: { check: { on: { PASSED: 'review' } }, review: {} } });
input.test: test('graph transition', () => { const actor = createActor(machine).start(); actor.send({ type: 'PASSED' }); expect(actor.getSnapshot().value).toBe('review'); actor.stop(); });
input.context: createMachine/createActor are unmodified third-party XState APIs. No hooks or additional assertions.
input.contract: The graph author chose the names check and review and the PASSED edge. These are private configuration; no separately specified transition policy is provided.

rationale: Running an unchanged interpreter does not make a declaration-copy test an engine logic test.
